exposure: sonographic features of caesarean scar pregnancy
outcome: diagnostic accuracy of caesarean scar pregnancy
cohort: 66 pregnant women (30 with intrauterine pregnancy and 36 with caesarean scar pregnancy) between 4.9 and 11.9 weeks gestation
finding: Screening during early first trimester is important to improve the diagnostic accuracy of CSP, and a proposed algorithm using specific sonographic features is a useful tool to improve diagnostic accuracy and confidence.
